email.received.label: Device received
email.received.subject: We received your {device} — repair {number}
email.received.body:
Hi {name},

Thanks for choosing {company}. We have received your {device} under repair number {number}.
We will contact you as soon as we have a diagnosis.

{signature}
email.estimate.label: Estimate — needs approval
email.estimate.subject: Estimate for repair {number}
email.estimate.body:
Hi {name},

We have diagnosed your {device} (repair {number}).
The estimated cost of the repair is {estimate}.

Please reply to this email to approve the repair or let us know if you have any questions.

{signature}

Good news: your {device} (repair {number}) is ready for pickup.
Amount due: {total}.

Please bring your repair ticket when you collect it.

{signature}
